ios.desc:
Break the cycle. Reclaim your life.

Habitless is the sobriety tracker and recovery tool built for those serious about quitting. Whether you are focused on smoking, alcohol, or digital wellness — Habitless gives you the tools to stop for good.

WHAT MAKES HABITLESS DIFFERENT
Most apps track new habits. Habitless tracks your freedom. A precision sobriety counter combined with real-time financial savings turns recovery into a journey you can see and feel every day.

CORE FEATURES

Precision Sobriety Counter — Track your clean time down to the second, day and night.

Financial Savings Tracker — See exactly how much money you have reclaimed in real-time.

Milestone Badge System — Unlock 20+ psychological rewards from Day 1 to Total Freedom.

Relapse Insights — Log triggers like stress or boredom to identify patterns and build resilience.

Smart Notifications — Get alerted the moment you hit a new milestone or savings goal.

Secure Cloud Sync — Your progress is protected and synced across all your Apple devices.

WHAT YOU CAN TRACK

Chemical Habits: Support for smoking, vaping, and alcohol cessation.

Digital Wellness: Manage screen time and unhealthy digital behaviors.

Vitality: Track sugar, caffeine, and dietary discipline.

Financial Health: Monitor impulse spending and betting habits.

YOUR PRIVACY MATTERS
No ads. No judgment. Habitless is a minimalist, private space designed around your recovery journey.

HABITLESS PRO
Unlock the full experience with Monthly, Annual, or Lifetime access.

Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation. Subscription renews automatically unless cancelled 24 hours before the renewal date. Manage or cancel anytime in Apple Account Settings.

Privacy Policy: https://habitless.netlify.app/privacy-policy

quotes.text:
more bollocks

https://apps.apple.com/jp/app/habitless-quit-bad-habits/id6758941144

spelled id wong: haitless: habitless

no links to the claimed "science-backed" papers or research;

I worked in substance misuse as a methadone dispender, care coordinator, NHS detox units and rehabs across the UK for over 15 years.

Strike alcohol off that list, there is no way in a million years that any app will assist or help anyone addicted to alcohol to detox and cut down on their drinking.

fucking fantasists

Hi HN,

I built Habitless because I found that most trackers focus on building new routines, but the psychological challenge of quitting an addiction (like nicotine, alcohol, or even social media) requires a different approach.

I wanted a high-precision dashboard that treats recovery like a mission. I just released an update that adds iCloud sync and milestone notifications.

Key features:

Precision Streak Counter: Tracks your progress down to the second.

Financial Savings: A real-time tracker showing exactly how much money you’ve reclaimed.

Privacy: No third-party tracking. All data is backed up via iCloud/CloudKit.

Milestone System: Psychological badges to gamify the recovery process.

I’d love to hear your thoughts on the UI or the iCloud implementation.

App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/habitless-quit-addiction/id6758941144
